scope: Length-for-age, recumbent, sexes M/F, ages 0-730 days
transformation: Extract lenanthro.sas7bdat from the official igrowup-sas.zip archive.
Decode WHO sex codes 1=male and 2=female as M and F.
Retain loh=L (recumbent length), ages 0 through 730 days, and LMS columns.
Sort by sex and age_days and write the canonical sex,age_days,L,M,S CSV schema.

sources.name: WHO Child Growth Standards SAS macro package (igrowup-sas.zip), lenanthro.sas7bdat
Simplified field tables: Length-for-age BOYS, birth to 2 years (z-scores)
Simplified field tables: Length-for-age GIRLS, birth to 2 years (z-scores)

reference_cases.selection: Both sexes; birth through 24 months; median, negative, positive, and HAZ=-2 threshold rows from the separate rounded WHO field tables.
reference_cases.tolerance: 0.05 HAZ, allowing for source lengths rounded to 0.1 cm and nominal month-to-day conversion.
